5. RESIDENT PRESENCE: Presence does not trigger drift for bathroom/bedroom. Kitchen drift is time-dependent (post-05:00). Absence of resident does NOT clear counter_k1 staging items.
6. PREDICTIVE RULES: 
- If time > 05:00, check counter_k1 for mug_mara, lunchbox_mara, tablet_mara (high prob). Do NOT predict plate_shared_2 here.
- If resident_1 absent, static anchors (bathroom_shelf, nightstand, desk) are reliable, but phone_mara may be in bathroom.
- counter_k1 items persist without resident.
7. CALIBRATION: For counter_k1 core items (mug, lunchbox, tablet) during 05:00-08:00, assign 0.5-0.7 probability. Do not use 0.15 (too low) or 0.8 (too high if plate included). Plate_shared_2 at counter_k1 is <0.2.", "why": "Belief 7 and scratch memory incorrectly assumed plate_shared_2 co-occurs with the core three at counter_k1 and that high probabilities (0.6-0.8) apply to all four. d12 showed plate_shared_2 absent and resident absent, yet core three present.
